summary: Add divide support to the calculator
description: Extend POST /api/v1/calculate to support the divide operation without regressing existing calculator behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A request with operation divide, left 84, and right 2 should return HTTP 200 with a result of 42.
A divide request with a zero right operand should return HTTP 422 with the error code division_by_zero.
An outdated test using the divide operation exists in the current test suite and is considered obsolete.
Existing tests unrelated to divide remain passing.
